mapper.sql: select r.record_id, r.user_id, coalesce(r.login_name, u.login_name) as login_name, coalesce(r.user_name_snapshot, u.user_name) as user_name, coalesce(r.dept_id_snapshot, u.dept_id) as dept_id_snapshot, coalesce(r.dept_name_snapshot, d.dept_name) as dept_name_snapshot, r.device_user_no, r.punch_time, r.source_type, r.device_name, r.device_no, r.device_area, r.punch_type, r.sync_batch_no, r.sync_time, r.record_status, r.invalid_reason, r.source_db_key, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from hr_attendance_record r left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = coalesce(r.dept_id_snapshot, u.dept_id)
mapper.insert: insert into hr_attendance_record( user_id, login_name, user_name_snapshot, dept_id_snapshot, dept_name_snapshot, device_user_no, punch_time, source_type, device_name, device_no, device_area, punch_type, sync_batch_no, sync_time, record_status, invalid_reason, source_db_key, create_by, create_time ) values( #{userId}, #{loginName}, #{userName}, #{deptIdSnapshot}, #{deptNameSnapshot}, #{deviceUserNo}, #{punchTime}, #{sourceType}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceNo}, #{deviceArea}, #{punchType}, #{syncBatchNo}, #{syncTime}, #{recordStatus}, #{invalidReason}, #{sourceDbKey}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
